primitives.name: Glasgow Coma Score severity partition (mild/moderate/severe)
primitives.verbatim_quote: The most widely used index of injury severity is the Glasgow Coma Score (GCS) which classifies injuries into mild, moderate or severe categories based on level of consciousness post injury
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: g = Glasgow Coma Scale total score (eye+verbal+motor), a dimensionless ordinal integer on {3,...,15} (no physical unit; pure count of behavioural response levels). S(g) = severity class label, a categorical (nominal) variable, dimensionless. The thresholds 13, 12, 9, 8 are dimensionless score cut-points taken verbatim from Table 1. No SI quantity appears; the map is a partition of an ordinal score axis, so it is trivially dimensionally homogeneous (label = function of a dimensionless score).
primitives.assumptions: Severity is indexed by level of consciousness post injury via GCS; the published cut-points are Mild 13-15, Moderate 9-12, Severe 8 or less (Table 1). The guideline explicitly assumes the partition is a convenience imposed on a continuous severity dimension, and that definitions match those used in each supporting study, so the labels may vary between sections.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails at the cusp of categories and for 'complicated mild' injury: injuries with skull fracture or substantive haematoma are not generally considered mild despite a GCS of 13-15. The guideline warns symptom severity may not correlate perfectly with GCS-defined injury severity, so a severe-injury patient can share symptoms with a mild one. The partition is therefore not a faithful proxy for disability or prognosis near boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to discretising a continuous latent load/impact state into discrete operational regimes that gate a decision kernel. In the 22-player football dynamical system, a continuous collision-load or fatigue accumulator is bucketed into availability regimes (full / limited / out) exactly as GCS buckets consciousness into mild/moderate/severe; the bucket boundary, not the raw score, switches which transition kernel (play-call eligibility, substitution policy) is active. The source invariant is the boundary-induced regime switch and its known misclassification near the cusp.
layer2.telemetry: GCS eye/verbal/motor sub-scores, duration of loss of consciousness, post-traumatic amnesia duration, and imaging for fracture/haematoma calibrate the regime assignment; in the football analogue, instrumented impact counts and wellness scores calibrate the availability bucket. Boundary cases flagged LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE until complicated-mild imaging resolves them.

primitives.name: WHO operational definition of mild traumatic brain injury (conjunctive gate)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mild traumatic brain injury is an acute brain injury resulting from mechanical energy to the head from external force.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t_LOC = duration of loss of consciousness, time, SI unit seconds (s) expressed clinically in minutes (min); threshold 30 min = 1800 s. t_PTA = duration of post-traumatic amnesia, time, SI unit seconds (s) expressed in hours (h); threshold 24 h = 86400 s. g_30 = GCS score assessed at 30 minutes post injury or later, dimensionless ordinal integer in [13,15]. C = confounder predicate (drugs/alcohol/other injury/psychological trauma/language barrier/penetrating craniocerebral injury), dimensionless boolean. The expression is a boolean conjunction of thresholded time quantities and a dimensionless score; each comparison is unit-consistent (time vs time, score vs score), so it is dimensionally homogeneous.
primitives.assumptions: Acute brain injury from mechanical energy to the head from external force; operational criteria require (i) one or more of confusion/disorientation, LOC <=30 min, PTA <24 h, or other transient neurological abnormalities, AND (ii) GCS 13-15 after 30 minutes or later, AND manifestations not attributable to drugs, alcohol, other injuries/treatment, other problems, or penetrating craniocerebral injury. Diagnosis is retrospective in the post-acute phase.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The guideline states this imposes a categorical definition for convenience on a dimension of severity; injuries at the cusp (skull fracture, substantive haematoma = complicated mild) are not generally considered mild and require separate consideration. Retrospective PTA assessment may be less reliable; recall bias and misattribution of pre-existing symptoms degrade the gate. The confounder exclusion clause is the load-bearing assumption that fails in intoxication or polytrauma.

layer2.mapping: Derived as a conjunctive eligibility gate on a transition kernel: a state is admitted to the 'mild' regime only when an existential sign-clause AND a score-window AND a negated-confounder clause all hold. In the football system this is the structure of a multi-condition participation gate (e.g. medical clearance AND load-window AND no-flag) that must fire jointly before a player re-enters the high-intensity transition kernel; the derived lesson is that the negated-confounder term, not the headline threshold, carries the safety burden and is the first term to silently fail.
layer2.telemetry: LOC duration, PTA duration, GCS at >=30 min, and a documented confounder screen (toxicology, imaging, mechanism) calibrate the gate; absent a reliable confounder screen the admission is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE and must default to the more conservative regime.

primitives.name: Vegetative state diagnostic criteria and aetiology-dependent permanence gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Diagnosis of VS can only be made a minimum of one month after injury and requires the presence of all the following
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t = time elapsed since injury, time, SI unit seconds (s) expressed clinically in months; thresholds 12 months and 3 months are time intervals (1 month ~ 2.63e6 s nominal). e = aetiology class, a dimensionless categorical variable in {traumatic, non-traumatic (e.g. cerebral anoxia)}. permanentVS = boolean prognosis flag, dimensionless. Diagnosis of VS itself requires a minimum t >= 1 month post injury. All comparisons are time-vs-time, so the predicate is dimensionally homogeneous; no force/energy quantity is mixed with time.
primitives.assumptions: VS diagnosis requires ALL of: no awareness of self/environment and inability to interact; no sustained, reproducible, purposeful or voluntary behavioural responses to stimuli; no language comprehension or expression; intermittent wakefulness with sleep-wake cycles; preserved hypothalamic/brain-stem autonomic function; bowel/bladder incontinence; variably preserved cranial/spinal reflexes. Minimum one month post injury. Permanence is aetiology-conditioned (12 months traumatic, 3 months non-traumatic).
primitives.breakdown_regime: After the permanence threshold recovery of consciousness is 'highly improbable but not impossible' — the gate is probabilistic, not absorbing. Critically, up to 40% of patients labelled chronic/persistent VS actually show behavioural responses consistent with the minimally conscious state (MCS), so the diagnostic predicate has a large false-negative rate when assessed without a validated scale (CRS-R) and trained examiners. The state boundary is observability-limited, not a true dynamical singularity.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a time-conditioned, hysteresis-bearing state classifier over a latent awareness variable inferred only through behavioural observables. In the football system this mirrors declaring a player 'chronically unavailable' after an aetiology-specific dwell time (contact vs non-contact injury), where the label gates long-horizon roster/transition kernels but is reversible and frequently misread from limited observations. The source invariant is that the chronicity gate is aetiology-dependent and that the latent state can exceed what the observable channel reveals.
layer2.telemetry: Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) sub-scores, documented sleep-wake cycles, and reproducible purposeful responses (command following, visual tracking, functional communication) calibrate the VS/MCS boundary; functional imaging of cortical activation to salient stimuli is an auxiliary channel. Without repeated CRS-R the classification is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE.

primitives.name: Compensatory-over-restitution invariant in cognitive rehabilitation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Compensatory approaches refer to interventions that aim to improve functioning in everyday life by provision of some form of aid or strategy that compensates for a deficit but does not aim to restore normal operation of the cognitive process.
primitives.assumptions: Cognitive rehabilitation splits into compensatory approaches (aids/strategies that improve everyday functioning without restoring the underlying process) and restitution approaches (repetitive practice aimed at restoring normal function). The evidence base assumes outcome is measured at the level of activity and participation (everyday functioning), not impairment reduction; most interventions sit inside a broader holistic programme addressing mood, emotion and behaviour.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The invariant 'interventions that aim to reduce levels of impairment are less effective' is domain- and measure-dependent: it holds for functional outcomes in moderate/severe TBI but the guideline notes within-domain evidence volume is small and quality very variable, and that impairment-focused attention training can produce small post-acute effects whose generalisation is weak. It does not license abandoning restitution where specific information learning (e.g. errorless learning) is the target.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to routing around a damaged substrate rather than repairing it: when a node's capacity is structurally reduced, an external compensator that preserves system-level function outperforms attempts to restore the node's original operation. In the 22-player system, adapting the scheme (play-calls, spacing, substitution structure) to a depleted player preserves team function better than forcing the original high-load scheme through that player. The source invariant is the functional-outcome superiority of compensation over restitution under structural deficit.
layer2.telemetry: Functional Independence Measure / Functional Assessment Measure (FIM/FAM), community integration questionnaire, and strategy-adherence logs calibrate the compensator's effect; impairment-level test scores alone are the wrong observable and can mislead. Where only impairment measures exist the functional benefit is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE.

primitives.name: Amantadine transient recovery-rate kernel with washout convergence
primitives.verbatim_quote: whilst both groups improved during the four-week treatment period (measured by changes on the CRS-R) the active treatment group demonstrated a significantly faster rate of recovery.
primitives.assumptions: Randomised placebo-controlled trial, n=184, severe TBI enrolled 4-16 weeks post injury, presenting in VS or MCS; outcome is rate of change on the Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (CRS-R) over a four-week treatment period, dosage 200-400 mg/day amantadine. Assumes both arms improve (natural recovery) and that the treatment effect is on the RATE of recovery, not the asymptotic endpoint; a two-week washout follows.
primitives.breakdown_regime: During washout the active group's improvement slowed such that by six weeks there was no significant between-group difference in CRS-R — the rate advantage is transient and doesn't shift the long-run attractor. Earlier smaller RCTs gave inconsistent results (design/sample/duration differences). The effect is a convergence-speed modification, not a durable endpoint gain; extrapolating it to a permanent outcome benefit violates the observed washout convergence.

layer2.mapping: Derived as a transient rate-boost kernel that accelerates convergence to a shared attractor without moving the attractor: dX/dt is increased during the intervention window but the fixed point X* is unchanged, so integrated long-run gain is zero. In the football system this is the structure of a short-term intervention (e.g. a load-management or arousal block) that speeds return-to-form but does not raise the ceiling; the derived discipline is to value it for time-to-recovery, not for terminal performance, and to stop crediting it once the washout convergence appears.
layer2.telemetry: CRS-R trajectory (slope during treatment vs washout), amantadine dose in mg/day, and time-since-injury at enrolment calibrate the rate kernel; the six-week post-washout CRS-R difference is the falsifier that distinguishes a rate effect from an endpoint effect. Endpoint-only measurement is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE for the rate claim.

reasoning_traces.think: Begin from the epistemic situation this guideline is built to manage: a clinician must act on a damaged brain whose internal state is only partially observable, and must do so under a evidence base the guideline itself describes as small, heterogeneous, and dominated by single-case designs. The first move is to notice that the document's deepest invariant is not any single treatment but a discipline of classification under uncertainty. The Glasgow Coma Score partition (p1) turns a continuous severity dimension into three operational buckets, and the guideline is unusually honest that this is a convenience imposed on a continuum, that symptom severity need not track the bucket, and that complicated-mild injuries with fracture or haematoma sit at the cusp and break the label. That honesty is the cognitive source code: a discrete regime switch is useful precisely because it gates which decision kernel runs, but its boundaries are where misclassification lives. The WHO mild-TBI gate (p2) generalises the same structure into a conjunction: an existential sign clause, a score window, and a negated-confounder clause must all fire. Reading these together, the hidden state that matters is not the headline threshold but the load-bearing exclusion term — the drugs/alcohol/other-injury/penetrating-injury clause — because that is the term that silently fails in the messy real cases (intoxication, polytrauma) and admits a patient to the wrong regime. The retrocausal lesson is that the field's historical scar is over-reading a categorical label as a mechanism: the guideline explicitly rejects 'post-concussional syndrome' as implying neuronal damage the evidence does not support, and rejects routine psychometric referral after MTBI because false positives abound without effort testing. So the lineage that produced these gates is a lineage of correcting earlier over-confidence, of learning that a convenient category is not a causal claim. Now the compensatory-over-restitution invariant (p4) lands as the same epistemic humility applied to intervention: when the substrate is structurally damaged, the evidence says routing around the deficit with aids and strategies beats trying to restore the original operation, measured at the level of everyday functioning rather than impairment. The theory-of-mind clash here is between the therapist's comfort with restitution (it feels like healing, it is intuitive, it matches the medical model of fixing the broken part) and the patient's actual functional goal (return to work, to family, to meaningful activity). A clinician attached to impairment-level test scores will keep prescribing repetitive practice that the evidence shows is less effective for function, while the patient's valued outcome stagnates. The cross-layer veto is decisive: the psychology of functional participation vetoes the high-EV-looking but wrong-target restitution call, because the observable that matters (FIM/FAM, community integration) is not the observable the comfort call optimises (impairment score). Selecting the wrong outcome measure makes a meaningful intervention look meaningless, and the guideline says so explicitly. The sovereign move is therefore to bind every decision to the functional observable and to treat the impairment measure as a potentially misleading channel.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The gates in this guideline were forged by a history of over-reading categories as mechanisms. The explicit rejection of 'post-concussional syndrome' as implying unsupported neuronal damage, the warning that symptom severity need not track GCS-defined severity, and the refusal to recommend routine psychometric referral after mild TBI because false positives proliferate without effort testing, all descend from earlier cohorts in which clinicians mistook a convenient label for a causal claim and mistook litigation-driven poor effort for brain damage. The WHO confounder-exclusion clause and the complicated-mild caveat are the scar tissue of that correction: the field learned, retrospectively, that the boundary cases and the excluded confounders are where the real errors live, so the modern gate is built to fail closed there rather than to celebrate its headline threshold.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Under pressure the therapist's comfort call is restitution: repetitive practice feels like healing, matches the medical model of fixing the broken part, and produces tidy impairment-level test scores that reassure the clinician. The patient's internal model is different — the valued goal is return to work, family and meaningful activity, not a better test number. The guideline stages this clash explicitly when it notes that a highly meaningful intervention can appear meaningless if the wrong outcome measure is selected, and that goals vary across participants so simple metrics are not universal. A clinician who models the patient as wanting impairment reduction will keep prescribing the less-effective intervention; correctly modelling the patient's functional goal flips the prescription toward compensation.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: The psychology of functional participation vetoes the high-EV-looking restitution call. The veto fires because the observable the comfort call optimises (an impairment score) is not the observable that carries the patient's outcome (FIM/FAM, community integration, return to work). The evidence layer supplies the warrant: interventions aiming to reduce impairment are less effective for everyday functioning, and impairment-focused attention gains generalise weakly. So even when restitution looks expected-value-positive on its own narrow metric, the cross-layer adjudication rejects it in favour of compensatory strategies bound to the functional channel, and marks the impairment-only reading as a misleading, potentially LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE proxy for what actually matters.

reasoning_traces.think: The second cluster concerns time, observability, and the difference between speeding convergence and moving the attractor. The vegetative-state predicate (p3) is a time-conditioned classifier over a latent awareness state inferred only through behaviour, and its permanence gate is aetiology-dependent: twelve months for traumatic cause, three for non-traumatic. Two facts make this a rigorous invariant rather than a label. First, the gate is probabilistic — recovery beyond it is highly improbable but not impossible — so it must never be coded as an absorbing state. Second, and more damning, up to forty percent of patients labelled chronic vegetative are actually minimally conscious when assessed properly, which means the observable channel systematically under-reports the latent state. The historical scar producing the CRS-R recommendation is exactly this misdiagnosis literature: the field learned that unstructured bedside judgement misses purposeful responses, so a validated scale and trained examiners became the calibration instrument. The theory-of-mind pressure is on the family and the clinical team who, facing a seemingly unresponsive patient, drift toward the comfort of a permanence narrative that forecloses rehabilitation; the guideline's veto is that the latent state can exceed the observable, so a premature absorbing label is a category error with ethical weight. Now the amantadine kernel (p5) supplies the dynamical-systems counterpart. In the n=184 placebo-controlled trial both arms improved over four weeks, but the active arm improved faster; crucially, during the two-week washout the active arm's rate slowed and by six weeks there was no significant between-group difference on the CRS-R. The invariant is therefore a transient rate boost that accelerates convergence to a shared attractor without shifting the attractor itself. The retrocausal genealogy is the field's repeated confusion of speed with ceiling: earlier smaller amantadine RCTs were inconsistent, and the temptation is to read a faster early recovery as a permanently better outcome. The cross-layer veto adjudicates this cleanly: the pharmacology (a dopaminergic arousal effect on rate) is vetoed as a justification for any durable endpoint claim, because the washout convergence is the falsifier that separates a rate effect from an endpoint effect. In the football analogue this is the discipline of valuing a load-management or arousal block for time-to-recovery rather than terminal performance, and of withdrawing credit the moment the washout convergence appears. Composing p3 and p5 yields the unified source code: under partial observability, classify states with validated, repeatable instruments and aetiology-aware time gates that stay reversible; and when an intervention changes a trajectory, measure the slope and the asymptote separately, because an agent that confuses the two will systematically over-credit transient accelerations as permanent gains. The honest, fail-closed posture is to mark the latent state LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE whenever the calibration channel (repeated CRS-R, a documented confounder screen, a washout follow-up) is absent, rather than laundering an unverified label into a decision.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The vegetative-state and amantadine invariants carry two distinct historical scars. The CRS-R recommendation descends from the misdiagnosis literature showing that up to forty percent of patients labelled chronic vegetative are actually minimally conscious, a finding that exposed unstructured bedside judgement as systematically under-reporting latent awareness and forced the field to adopt validated, repeatable instruments and trained examiners. The amantadine rate kernel descends from a sequence of inconsistent small trials and the temptation to read faster early recovery as a permanently better outcome; the larger placebo-controlled trial with its washout phase was the corrective that separated speed from ceiling. Both lineages teach the same retrocausal lesson: the hidden state (true awareness, true asymptote) was being overwritten by a convenient but under-calibrated observable, and the modern protocol exists to stop that overwrite.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The belief clash under pressure is between the clinical team and family who, facing a seemingly unresponsive patient, drift toward the comfort of a permanence narrative that forecloses further rehabilitation, and the guideline's insistence that the latent state can exceed the observable channel. The team models the patient as permanently unaware because that resolves the emotional and ethical burden of continued effort; the patient's actual latent state may be minimally conscious and rehabilitation-relevant. A second clash sits in the amantadine reading: the prescriber wants to believe the faster recovery is a durable gain, while the trial's washout convergence says it is only a rate effect. Correctly modelling both the patient's hidden awareness and the drug's true dynamical effect prevents premature foreclosure and over-credit.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Two vetoes adjudicate. First, the observability layer vetoes any absorbing-state reading of the permanence gate: because recovery beyond the threshold is not impossible and misdiagnosis rates reach forty percent, a premature 'permanent' label is rejected in favour of repeated CRS-R assessment, with the state held LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE until calibrated. Second, the pharmacology layer vetoes using a transient rate boost as justification for a durable endpoint claim: the washout convergence at six weeks is the falsifier, so the high-EV-looking narrative of permanent amantadine benefit is rejected, and the intervention is credited only for time-to-recovery. The unified veto is that an agent must measure slope and asymptote separately and never launder an unverified label or a transient acceleration into a permanent decision.

universal_lens: A polymath audit lens for decision-making under partial observability: separate the latent state from the observable channel, classify with validated repeatable instruments and reversible aetiology-aware time gates, bind every intervention to the outcome that actually carries value (function, not impairment), and measure the slope and the asymptote of any trajectory separately so that transient accelerations are never mistaken for permanent gains. The unifying discipline is fail-closed calibration: when the calibration channel is absent, mark the state unidentifiable rather than laundering a convenient label into action.
gsi_mapping: For GSI this maps directly onto clinical telemetry and bioenergetics of the injured brain: GCS sub-scores, LOC and PTA durations, and CRS-R trajectories are the observables that calibrate consciousness and severity states, while the amantadine result is a dopaminergic-arousal rate effect on recovery that converges at washout, cautioning against crediting transient arousal gains as durable neural repair. The compensatory-over-restitution invariant informs rehabilitation dosing and the choice of functional versus impairment endpoints, and the confounder-exclusion gate parallels screening for intoxication, pain, urinary retention and constipation as remediable drivers of agitation before attributing behaviour to the injury itself.
gse_mapping: For GSE the primitives compile into Coach-Mind simulation and deception/portfolio tail-risk discipline: the GCS and WHO gates are conjunctive eligibility kernels that decide which player-state regime a play-call or substitution policy may run, with the negated-confounder term carrying the safety burden; the vegetative-state classifier is a reversible, aetiology-aware availability label that must not become absorbing; and the amantadine kernel is the canonical warning that a short-term intervention which speeds return-to-form does not raise the ceiling, so DFS/portfolio models must value time-to-recovery separately from terminal performance and withdraw credit at washout convergence. Compensation over restitution becomes scheme adaptation around a depleted player rather than forcing the original high-load scheme.
